description.value: Lakesider Brewing Co is a craft microbrewery and taproom in West Kelowna inspired by the Okanagan's lakeside lifestyle, producing easy-drinking beers designed for patio sipping alongside a full food menu that includes pizza and a kids menu. The taproom is family- and pet-friendly, serves locally sourced Okanagan wines alongside house cocktails, and hosts regular community events. Lakesider is featured on both the Kelowna and West Kelowna Ale Trails, making it a natural destination for cyclists exploring the region's craft beer scene.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM record: address '835 ANDERS ROAD WEST KELOWNA', phone '236-766-1144', and a functioning brewery taproom with food, events, and an active beer menu. A banner reading 'LAKESIDER WILL BE CLOSED SATURDAY MAY 30TH @ 2:00 PM' indicates a one-time partial closure on a specific date, not a permanent closure. Takeout is confirmed by a dedicated 'BEERS TO GO' page offering canned tall cans, growler fills, and Skip the Dishes home delivery; vegan/vegetarian options are tagged in OSM (diet:vegan=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes) but are not independently verifiable from the scraped website text alone.
concerns: Website displays a temporary closure notice ('LAKESIDER WILL BE CLOSED SATURDAY MAY 30TH @ 2:00 PM') — appears to be a single-day event closure, not indicative of permanent closure.
Website navigation includes 'filler@godaddy.com', a GoDaddy template placeholder, suggesting the site may not have been fully configured; however, all substantive content appears real and current.
OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes could not be independently confirmed from the scraped website text.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating craft brewery and taproom with a full website, regular events, and food and drink service; a listed stop on the Kelowna and West Kelowna Ale Trails and a natural destination for touring cyclists.
